Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to suspend then unsuspend this Digimon itself after playing or digivolving into it?
If I use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to suspend then unsuspend this Digimon itself after playing or digivolving into it, does this card's [All Turns] effect activate?

Effect: {Hand}[Counter] ＜Blast Digivolve＞ (One of your Digimon may digivolve into this card without paying the cost.)
[On Play][When Digivolving] Suspend 1 Digimon. Then, unsuspend 1 Digimon.
[All Turns][Once Per Turn] When this Digimon becomes suspended, you may play 1 Tamer card or 1 Digimon card with 4000 DP or less from your hand without paying the cost.
Special Rule: ＜Overflow (-4)＞ (As this card moves from the battle area or under a card to another area, lose 4 memory.)
